name: usage-budget
description: Warns as the account's 5-hour and 7-day usage windows fill, tells the model as they near the limit, refuses new subagents past a set percent, and warns and refuses them when 7-day usage runs ahead of the share of the week that has passed

spawnGatePercent.title: Refuse new subagents at (percent)
spawnGatePercent.description: When either usage window reaches this percent, a new subagent spawn is refused. 0 turns the refusal off.

warnPercents.title: Warn at (percents, comma separated)
warnPercents.description: Each time a usage window first reaches one of these percents, you get a toast. It starts over when the window resets.

tellModelAtPercent.title: Tell the model from (percent)
tellModelAtPercent.description: From this percent on, the model also gets a one-time note on its next tool result, so it can wrap up. 0 never tells the model.

paceMargin.title: Pace margin (points)
paceMargin.description: When 7-day usage runs this many points or more ahead of the share of the week that has passed, you get a toast, the model gets a note, and new subagents are refused until the week catches up. 0 turns the pace check off.

usage_file.title: Latest usage file
usage_file.description: Each time the usage figures come in, they are also written to this JSON file, so a session can read them. A leading <config> stands for your Claude config folder (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else the .claude folder in your home folder). An empty value turns the file off.
